languagePanel.clockHint: System follows your language's default (12-hour for US English, 24-hour elsewhere). Pick a side if you'd rather override that.

videoStudioRuntimeBanner.cudaTorchRestartIntro: The running backend still has the old torch in its module cache. Restart the backend to activate the new wheel
videoStudioRuntimeBanner.longLiveDescription: LongLive runs in an isolated venv at
videoStudioRuntimeBanner.longLiveDescriptionTail: so its CUDA-specific deps don't clash with the main runtime. Install can take 10–20 minutes — pip deps, optional flash-attn build, then ~8 GB of HF weights.
videoStudioRuntimeBanner.mlxVideoDescription: Adds native MLX video generation for Wan2.1 / Wan2.2 / LTX-2 on Apple Silicon — faster than diffusers+MPS once the generation path lands.
videoStudioRuntimeBanner.mp4EncoderPrompt: Video generation needs imageio + imageio-ffmpeg to write mp4 files. Install them into the backend environment now?
videoStudioRuntimeBanner.tokenizerDepsIntro: Some video models load tokenizer / text-encoder packages on demand. The following are missing and would block generation:
videoStudioRuntimeBanner.tokenizerDepsOutro: Install them now to avoid a mid-generate error.
videoStudioRuntimeBanner.gpuRuntimeInstalledOutro: The running backend still has its old import cache — click Restart Backend to activate the new runtime, then video generation will use it.
videoStudioRuntimeBanner.gpuRuntimeInstallPrompt: Video generation needs the GPU runtime bundle (torch + diffusers + tokenizers, ~2.5 GB). Install it once — it writes to a persistent user-local directory so subsequent app updates don't re-download it.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Choose how the sidebar organises grouped tabs. Switches are instant and remembered across restarts.
appearance.sidebarCollapsibleHelp: shows all groups expanded with children listed inline — one click per destination.
appearance.sidebarTabsHelp: keeps the sidebar compact: groups behave like single buttons that jump to their last-used tab, with a sub-tab bar above the content.
appearance.uiScaleHelp: UI scale changes the app chrome density immediately. Media previews keep their own aspect-ratio sizing.

dataDirectory.title: Data Directory
dataDirectory.subtitle: Where ChaosEngineAI stores chat history, settings, and benchmark runs. Change to a cloud-synced folder (Dropbox, iCloud) to back up or share across machines.
dataDirectory.helpText: Changes take effect after the backend restarts. Existing data will be copied to the new location; the old files are left in place.

deliveryFolders.title: Delivery Folders
deliveryFolders.subtitle: Where newly generated images and videos land. Override the defaults to drop finished renders straight into a client folder, Dropbox sync, or an external SSD.
deliveryFolders.helpText: New artifacts go to the folder you pick right away — no backend restart needed. Existing renders stay where they were written. Reset returns the row to the default under the Data Directory.

modelDirectories.title: Model Directories
modelDirectories.subtitle: Add the folders ChaosEngineAI should scan for local models, including custom paths and shared model directories.

providers.title: Remote Providers
providers.subtitle: Configure cloud OpenAI-compatible APIs as a fallback. Keys are stored locally with 0600 permissions.
providers.emptyState: No remote providers configured. Add one to use cloud models as a fallback.

huggingFace.helpText: Stored locally. Used by MLX conversion when fetching gated models from Hugging Face.
